# Reflection
## Inactivity Gap
21-09-02 to 24-03-06
## Discussion
This project is definitely one of the weirder ones according to its commit chart. It had a few high-volume commit times before collapsing and eventually becoming inactive. The only reason I can find for this is that it is managed by a academic group, meaning that they could have had a period of working on it before being forced to deal with other priorities. I am not to well versed on the subject of the repo, but it appears that after the groups publication that they eventually stepped away from the project altogether. The one commit that broke the inactivity gap was only a document change, so it appears that they are all finished with commits.
